weighting: combined = 3*US + UK + 0.45*Albums + 1.0*Grammy prestige (US/UK era-normalized to 100/chart-yr; album_raw = Total EAS millions; prestige = Big Four wins*3 + noms, split among co-credits, BNA*0.8)
scoring: per single raw=(11-peak)*sqrt(weeks); era-normalized to 100 pts/chart-year; collab score split equally among credited artists
